verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a documented local API bundled with the desktop app. It has a published, versioned OpenAPI spec (openapi-v2.yaml, dated releases, changelog) and a reference covering spaces, objects, properties, types, templates, files and chats. A headless CLI and an MCP server make it drivable by agents. The OpenAPI probe 404s were on doc.anytype.io, not developers.anytype.io where the spec actually lives, so they do not contradict this. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, written deprecation policy and try-it console, and a remote (non-localhost) API since v2 is still pre-release.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Our API is now available and directly included with the desktop app, running entirely on localhost.
Learn how to query, retrieve, and update spaces, objects, properties, types, and templates to build powerful extensions.
Anytype publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI document at developers.anytype.io/openapi-v2.yaml
Upload, download, and delete files in spaces
Anytype CLI is now available - run Anytype as a headless server for automation and scripting.
